integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Seamless 3D animation, cinematic with anamorphic lens and shallow depth of field, a high three-quarter aerial view opens on the large pillow-top mattress shown in <Picture 1>, floating tilted at a slight diagonal among a dense sea of cumulus clouds, its quilted white top with soft blue swirl patterns, navy blue ribbed side panels, and cream mesh border band fully preserved. Warm light from the upper left glints on the quilting while foreground and background clouds stay softly blurred. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the mattress bobs subtly, weightless, and clouds drift slowly past. At around 2.5 seconds, the mattress contracts seamlessly to queen size, its proportions and quilting detail scaling down continuously with no cut, while a soft puff of cloud mist swirls around it during the transition. At around 4.5 seconds, it shrinks again in one smooth morph to baby size, now looking tiny within the vast cloud sea, drifting slightly upward and forward as it lightens. Toward the end, the baby-size mattress settles gently onto the clouds, warm light glinting on its quilted top, the camera still holding its slow push-in.

overall_soundscape: A soft, airy wind drifts across the cloudscape with a faint low atmospheric hum. Gentle whooshes of displaced air accompany each size-shifting morph, and a delicate misty swirl sound rises softly as the mattress settles.
